BUG FOUND+FIXED: grid `items-start` on the detail page's 2-col layout shrank the section-nav column's own box to its content height (~330px) instead of the row's full height, breaking `sticky` after ~300px of scroll (containing block too short to stick in). Fix: dropped items-start so the column stretches to match the tall content column; sticky then has the full row to roam. Verified via scroll-spy screenshot post-fix.

BUG FOUND+FIXED: ImageThumb/YoutubeThumb onError on an rendered with `src` set on first paint can lose the race against hydration - the browser starts fetching from the server-rendered HTML during initial parse and a fast cross-origin 404/ORB-block can resolve before React attaches that element's (non-delegated, non-bubbling) onError listener, silently dropping the failure. Fix: defer `src` to a post-mount effect (Skeleton shown until then) so the is a genuinely client-created element - attribute-set and listener-attach happen in the same synchronous commit, strictly before any possible async network completion. Verified: all 4 rows of a real 404'd image set show the fallback icon reliably on a fresh load+wait; real YouTube thumbnails still render correctly through the same code path.
